text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. speaker: Doctor
text:
The patient is a term male infant with bilious vomiting, a family history of pyloric stenosis, and an uncomplicated birth. Given the bilious nature of the vomiting, which indicates obstruction distal to the ampulla of Vater, I must rule out surgical emergencies like malrotation with volvulus first.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Volvulus (differential includes Duodenal Atresia or Jejunal/Ileal Atresia)
